guidance_fy27.src: Q4 FY26 release (8-K Ex. 99.1, 22-May-2026), 'Fiscal Year 2027 Guidance'; reiterated unchanged in the Q1 FY27 release (8-K Ex. 99.1, 24-Jul-2026)
guidance_fy27.ultra_basis: The releases do not say whether the FY27 guidance includes Ultra Mission Solutions. The guidance was issued on 22-May-2026, before the 19-Jun-2026 agreement, and reiterated unchanged on 24-Jul-2026, before the 24-Aug-2026 close. The model therefore treats it as excluding Ultra (assumption) and calibrates the legacy business, with Ultra added in its own block. Defy Security (closed 6-Apr-2026, within Q1 actuals) is inside the guidance and the Q1 y/y trend.
guidance_fy27.history_fy26: FY26 guidance history (8-K Ex. 99.1): 23-May-2025 revenue $12.0-12.5bn (0-4.0%), adj. EBITDA $1,315-1,370m (~11%), adj. EPS $6.20-6.55, FCF $700-800m; Q1 FY26 release (25-Jul-2025) FCF $900-1,000m (S174 cash tax benefit), other items unchanged; 24-Oct-2025 revenue $11.3-11.5bn ((4.0)-(6.0)%), adj. EBITDA $1,190-1,220m (mid-10%), adj. EPS $5.45-5.65, FCF $850-950m; 23-Jan-2026 revenue $11.3-11.4bn ((5.0)-(6.0)%), adj. EBITDA $1,195-1,215m, adj. EPS $5.95-6.15, FCF $825-900m, adjusted ETR 16-19%. FY26 actual: revenue $11,217m, adj. EBITDA $1,229m, adj. EPS $6.51, FCF $951m.

deals.defy: Defy Security, acquired 6-Apr-2026 for $235m subject to customary adjustments (cash on hand; Q1 FY27 CF payments for business acquisitions $220m). Provisional PPA (Q1 FY27 10-Q Note 5): goodwill $129m (partially tax deductible), intangibles $86m (contract-related, 8-year life), remaining net assets $20m (current billed and unbilled receivables $221m, non-current unbilled receivables $89m, current payables and accrued $212m, non-current accrued $80m).
deals.ultra: Ultra I&C Mission Solutions (Ultra Electronics Advanced Tactical Systems, Inc.): stock purchase agreement 19-Jun-2026 for $720m subject to adjustments (8-K Item 1.01, 22-Jun-2026); closed 24-Aug-2026 (8-K 24-Aug-2026, Ex. 99.1). Revenue and EBITDA not disclosed; the announcement (Ex. 99.1, 22-Jun-2026) says BAH 'expects revenue from this acquisition to grow at a strong double-digit rate for the next several years with EBITDA margins well above 20%'.
deals.contracts_sale: Sale of a group of contracts with the associated assets, liabilities and workforce, completed 30-Nov-2025: pre-tax net gain $6m in other income (expense) in FY26; goodwill -$6m (FY26 10-K Note 5). Revenue of the contracts sold not disclosed.
deals.global_commercial: Global Commercial was reported as its own customer type to FY2024 Q4 (10-K FY2024); from Q1 FY25 it is included in Civil (10-Q footnote) and from FY2026 Civil and Commercial is one customer type; from Q1 FY27 Defense and Intelligence are reported together as National Security (8-K Ex. 99.1, 24-Jul-2026, Exhibit 5).

debt.at_2026_06_30: 30-Jun-2026 (Q1 FY27 10-Q Note 8): Term Loan A-1 $714m (4.970%, due 7-Sep-2027), Term Loan A-2 $746m (4.870%, due 27-Feb-2031; amortises 0.625% of stated principal a quarter for two years, then 1.25%), Senior Notes 3.875% due Sep-2028 $700m, 4.000% due Jul-2029 $500m, 5.950% due Aug-2033 $650m, 5.950% due Apr-2035 $650m; unamortized costs ($24m); total $3,936m; current portion $19m. $1.5bn revolving credit facility undrawn. Interest-rate swaps $350m notional (mature Jun-2026 to Jun-2027).
debt.new_notes: 4-Aug-2026: $700m 5.375% Senior Notes due 2030 and $500m 5.900% Senior Notes due 2034 (8-K Items 1.01 / 2.03, 4-Aug-2026). Net proceeds ~$1,189m used to fund part of the Ultra acquisition, repay the $714m Term Loan A-1 in full, and for general corporate purposes (424B2, 30-Jul-2026, Use of Proceeds; as-adjusted cash $1,015m at 30-Jun-2026).

amort_sched.src: FY26 10-K Note 6 (estimated annual amortization of intangible assets held at 31-Mar-2026): FY2027 $81m, FY2028 $65m, FY2029 $53m, FY2030 $42m, FY2031 $35m, thereafter $43m (total $319m). Excludes Defy Security ($86m over eight years, ~$10.75m a year) and Ultra.

buyback: Share repurchase program $4,085m (raised by $500m on 22-Oct-2025); $634m remaining at 30-Jun-2026; Q1 FY27 purchases 0.6m shares for $50m under the program (Q1 FY27 10-Q Part II Item 2: average price $76 in May-2026, $74 in Jun-2026 for shares incl. tax withholding).
dividend: Quarterly dividend $0.59 per share (declared 24-Jul-2026, payable 28-Aug-2026; Q1 FY27 $0.59 paid, $73m).

price.src: User-provided share price ($75), recorded 12-Oct-2026. Cross-check: Q1 FY27 10-Q Part II Item 2 average repurchase prices $76 (May-2026) and $74 (Jun-2026).

share_count.q1_22_basic_note: Q1 FY22 weighted basic shares are not in the XBRL company facts as first filed or as later presented; left blank (GAAP EPS check uses diluted shares).
